name: memory_remember
description: Store a message in auditable memory. Trusted user statements become active records; content from webpages/tool output is quarantined until explicitly promoted. Updates supersede older facts with the same slot instead of duplicating.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

source_aliases.description: Typed host session aliases for a staged current user message.

interpreted_fact.description: Optional concise fact semantically interpreted by the host agent.

interpreted_fact_key.description: Optional stable semantic slot used to supersede an older value.

interpreter.description: Host model identity that produced interpreted_fact.

name: memory_observe
description: Store exactly one quarantined text observation derived from a host-controlled image, audio, video, or document. AtMem stores no media bytes: the caller supplies an exact-byte SHA-256 digest, secretless host reference, segment, and extractor identity. Generic MCP evidence is always marked caller_asserted; confidence is evidence, never promotion authority.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

media_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact media byte stream.

host_reference.description: Secretless host-controlled reference; no query string or credentials.

region.description: Page region label or serialized coordinates.

confidence.description: Extractor-local evidence only; never a trust threshold.

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 time at which the extractor observed the artifact.

artifact_id.description: Optional existing artifact id; its digest must match.

name: memory_recall
description: Legacy diagnostic search for active memories. This does not authorize prompt injection; use memory_recall_decision for that. Ranks by (text relevance + trust + recency). Every recall is logged with a bounded score sample for auditability.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

include_scores.description: Include each returned record's audited ranking score.

name: memory_recall_decision
description: Retrieve governed memory context using AtMem's shared calibrated direct/background/no-useful-memory decision and final eligibility reload.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

context_version.description: Use v2 for typed evidence sufficiency and action constraints.

name: memory_form_episode
description: Form source-linked typed memory proposals from exact episode parts. AtMem verifies every digest and applies governance; the tool does not bypass review, storage protection, scope, or activation.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

name: memory_get_record
description: Read one active memory by its exact record id and return its stored source provenance. The read is written to the audit chain.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

name: memory_get_source
description: Read an exact, digest-verified frozen OpenClaw source file (MEMORY.md or memory/*.md) admitted during takeover. The read is written to the audit chain.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

name: memory_recall_block
description: Build a bounded <relevant_memories> block for prompt injection: top matches only (lexical match required), hard record/char budgets, and an audit event naming exactly which record IDs entered the context.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

require_direct_support.description: Require calibrated direct original-query support for automatic injection.

exclude_record_ids.description: Records already present in another context component.

reference_mode.description: Model-visible provenance reference format; audit events always retain full IDs.

name: memory_persona
description: Deterministic persona snapshot (<user_persona> block) derived live from active records: stable fact slots first, then recent facts, under a character budget. Every line carries the source record id; building it is audited.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

reference_mode.description: Model-visible provenance reference format; audit events always retain full IDs.

name: memory_context_pack
description: Build a provider-neutral cache-aware context pack. Keep stable_context in a stable system-prefix position and put dynamic_context near the current turn. Both blocks are bounded and their full record provenance is audited.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

name: memory_capture
description: Auto-capture a conversation event. role=user runs the full write pipeline; role=assistant/tool_call/tool_result are logged to the audit chain as digests and never become memory records.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

name: memory_list
description: List a subject's records. include_inactive=true also shows superseded, quarantined, and tombstoned records.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

name: memory_forget
description: Delete matching memories: tombstone + purge content and the source episode. Returns a deletion receipt bound to the audit chain. Provide `contains` (substring) or `utterance` (e.g. "Forget my backup email.").

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

name: memory_forget_artifact
description: Purge every AtMem memory derived from one exact media byte stream, selected by its indexed SHA-256 digest. Returns a verifiable receipt. This does not delete the host's original file or semantically related re-encodings.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

artifact_id.description: Optional second identifier; must match the digest.

name: memory_promote
description: Activate a quarantined record and audit the trust transition. This tool does not authenticate confirmation; the host must show the record and enforce any required human approval.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

name: memory_audit
description: Return the hash-chained audit log, retrieval events, and whether the chain verifies.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

name: memory_verify
description: Verify audit-chain integrity, optionally against an anchored checkpoint file.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

name: memory_graph_status
description: Inspect derived graph entities, edges, merge proposals, and archives.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

name: memory_graph_merges
description: List entity merge proposals. Decisions require the reviewer HTTP or CLI surface.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

name: memory_graph_history
description: Read digest-verified inactive graph edges from cold partitions.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.

name: memory_log_action
description: Append an agent action event (tool call, decision, response shown) to the same audit chain as memory events. Put digests in the payload, not raw content.

subject_id.description: User/tenant scope; omit to use the server default.
